Data Engineer, Nykaa — Feb 2025 - Present
Built and maintained end-to-end ETL pipelines ingesting web and transactional data into BigQuery, improving daily data availability from 04:00 to 01:00 using Python and SQL. Implemented Spark-based batch transformations to normalize product and catalog feeds, reducing pipeline failures by 40%. Developed data validation jobs and Git-driven CI workflows to ensure deployment consistency. Collaborated with analytics teams to deliver dashboards and derived metrics that increased marketing ROI visibility.

Data Engineer, Infosys — Jan 2024 - Jan 2025
Designed and optimized AWS-hosted data processing workflows for client reporting, leveraging Spark on EMR and Python scripts for data cleansing and joins. Implemented incremental load strategies in SQL and Spark to cut processing time by 55%. Automated deployment and version control using Git; established alerting for pipeline regressions. Contributed to cost optimization efforts by right-sizing AWS compute and storage.

Big Data Engineer, Cognizant — Oct 2022 - Dec 2023
Developed Spark jobs to process large-scale event streams and transformed raw datasets into analytics-ready tables consumed by business teams. Migrated select workloads to AWS, introducing S3-based staging and Spark-based aggregation, which improved query performance for downstream BI by 30%. Worked with engineering peers to document data schemas and Git-managed codebase.

Skills: Python, SQL, Spark, AWS, BigQuery, Git

Education: MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
